subject.title: [Feature]: Allow restoring rejected skill workshop proposals back to pending

question: Should Skill Workshop support restoring rejected proposals back to pending through the service, gateway RPC, CLI, and UI surfaces proposed by the linked PR?
rationale: This is a new lifecycle/API capability rather than a strict bug fix, and it changes operator workflow semantics across multiple public surfaces.

options.title: Review linked PR for merge
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100894 as the active candidate, requesting proof and any API-shape adjustments there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the surface first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller service/CLI-only or service/API-first design if maintainers want less UI or protocol surface initially.

options.title: Reject restore semantics
options.body: Close both the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide rejected proposals must remain immutable history and users should recreate proposals instead.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR for merge
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100894 as the active candidate, requesting proof and any API-shape adjustments there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Skill Workshop lifecycle was introduced in this area by Vincent Koc's commit history, making that the strongest routing signal for the product/API decision.
